sources.version_date: SLSA specification v1.2; page status Approved
sources.locator: Build: Verifying artifacts; How to verify; Step 2: Check expectations; Step 3: Check dependencies recursively
sources.retrieval_operation: web search result followed by open
sources.source_statement: Verification includes signature, artifact subject digest, predicate type, trusted builder identity, source repository, buildType, and externalParameters checks; dependency recursion is optional and can be best effort.
sources.conditions_exceptions: Verifier expectations and roots of trust must be configured; the threat model assumes trust in selected build platforms and does not cover compromise of a trusted platform.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Direct fit for binding a supplied artifact to an accepted source and builder; mapping product names to expected repositories remains a product choice.

sources.version_date: SLSA specification v1.2; page status Approved
sources.locator: Provenance definition; Build provenance and Source provenance entries
sources.source_statement: SLSA describes provenance as verifiable information about where, when, and how artifacts were produced; build provenance tracks output back to source code.
sources.conditions_exceptions: This page is a general definition and directs predicate-specific readers to Build Provenance.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Supports treating provenance as a claim set whose acceptance still depends on verification and expectations.

sources.version_date: Documentation page last modified 2024-12-13; release version not stated on page
sources.retrieval_operation: web search result followed by open
sources.source_statement: Signed layouts define authorized functionaries and step rules; signed links carry step metadata; in-toto-verify checks signatures, expiry, authorized steps, rules, and inspections.
sources.conditions_exceptions: Only explicitly passed materials/products are recorded; default rules allow unspecified artifacts, and the docs recommend disallowing all remaining artifacts for most steps.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Fits a richer multi-step evidence chain when policy authors can maintain layouts and keys.

sources.version_date: Documentation as retrieved 2026-10-10; page did not state a release tag
sources.locator: Keyless verification using OpenID Connect; blob bundle verification; digest validation; Verify attestation
sources.retrieval_operation: web search result followed by open
sources.source_statement: Cosign supports identity/issuer constrained verification, bundle-based blob verification, digest checks, and an attestation verification command.
sources.conditions_exceptions: The docs warn that disabling claim checks leaves claims unverified; semantic policy over attestation predicates is still required.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Strong inspectable signing/identity component for detached installer artifacts; format-specific behavior must be confirmed.

sources.version_date: Documentation page; no release version stated
sources.retrieval_operation: web click from the official documentation index
sources.source_statement: Identical outputs from a given source allow multiple parties to compare results and flag build deviations.
sources.conditions_exceptions: This detects output differences but does not itself specify accepted repository, builder identity, or dependency policy.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Candidate independent corroboration for build-job compromise, conditional on reproducibility.

sources.version_date: Documentation index; no release version stated
sources.locator: Introduction; Define a build environment; Verification
sources.retrieval_operation: web search result followed by open
sources.source_statement: The documentation notes that build-system changes and a strategy for recreating the environment may be needed.
sources.conditions_exceptions: The index links multiple techniques; this page alone does not establish that a particular project is reproducible.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Supports treating cost and feasibility as open product questions rather than assuming universal reproducibility.

sources.version_date: GitHub main branch as rendered; document did not state a release version
sources.locator: Validation model, single artifact/single attestation pseudocode, output to policy engine
sources.retrieval_operation: web click from the SLSA verification page’s verifier link
sources.source_statement: The validation pseudocode checks recognized attesters and a matching artifact digest, then outputs predicate data for a policy engine.
sources.conditions_exceptions: Page says its model is for one artifact and one attestation and leaves multiple-attestation handling as TODO.
sources.applicability_or_inference: Supports separating cryptographic validation from semantic product-policy evaluation.
